name: The Bookshop Burglar and The Captain's Boots facts
notes: mw-e39.10: facts written and read by quest-bookshop-burglar and quest-captains-boots and by the Briar Glen dialogues they added scenes and options to. burglar.outcome, snig.lessons, hale.secret.kept, hale.secret.exposed and hale.sleepwalking.revealed are registered with the dialogues that read them (rootcellar-dialogue, hub-dialogue) and reused as they are.

facts.description: Mirela has told the player that books are going missing from the Lamplit Stacks and asked for a night watch (The Bookshop Burglar, bible 6.1 quest 1). Set by mirela-stacks (ask-books, or a thief accepting her retrieval job); starts the quest.
The player has sat up in the Stacks at night and seen the thief run (ink-smudged footprints lead out of the back door). Set by the stakeout scene in mirela-stacks.
Mirela has agreed to give Snig reading lessons for goblin salvage (burglar.outcome deal). Set by mirela-stacks; the deal resolution needs it.
Captain Hale has taken Snig into the cell (burglar.outcome turned-in) and paid the bounty. Set by hale-watch; the turn-in resolution needs it. The thief's jailbreak that follows is a later bead.
The player has told Mirela how the burglary ended, so she can react to it. Set by mirela-stacks.

The player has heard that Captain Hale's boots are dusty every morning (rumour 8 from Dot, or Juniper). Starts The Captain's Boots with hale.boots.asked and hale.boots.confessed. Set by dot-sleeping-ox and juniper-fenn.
The player has watched Hale sleepwalk toward the mine at night (The Captain's Boots, bible 6.1 quest 2). Set by the night scene in hale-watch; opens the ways of settling it.
The player followed Hale all the way along the sleepwalkers' route and learned the Briarwood shortcut (The Captain's Boots). Set by the night scene in hale-watch.
The sleepwalkers' route, and with it the Briarwood shortcut to the priory (bible 6.1 quest 2), is known. Set by the follow-the-route resolution of The Captain's Boots.

How the player is settling Hale's sleepwalking: wakeful tea, the wrong (sleep) draught, tying him to his bed with his consent, a bell on his door, or shadowing the route. A decision record set by hale-watch.
The draught Hale last drank on the player's word. Sleep at night starts the Hale walks in branch of The Captain's Boots (the quest reads it); cleared when he is brought home.
Hale agreed to be tied to his bed at night. Set by hale-watch.
A bell hangs on Hale's door so that he cannot leave unheard. Set by hale-watch.

Hale took the sleep draught and walked up the mine road in the night (the Hale walks in branch). Set by the quest on nightfall; hale-watch plays the fetching scene while it holds and hale.retrieved does not.
Hale has been fetched home from the mine gate after walking in. Set by hale-watch.
Juniper has brewed wakeful tea from the player's two bellwort roots. Set by juniper-fenn.
Juniper sold the player a sleep draught for the captain (the wrong draught). Set by juniper-fenn.
